pages.text: The $(item)Neko Collector$() is your $(#FF69B4)first essential tool$() on the journey to becoming a neko.$(br2)It absorbs energy from nearby nekos and cats, and once full — it produces a $(thing)Neko Potion$()!
Crafting the collector requires some basic materials: $(item)Sticks$() and $(item)Glass$().$(br2)Nothing too complicated — go gather the materials and craft one~

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: Using the $(item)Neko Collector$() couldn't be easier — $(#FF69B4)just hold it in your hand$()!$(br2)As long as there are $(thing)nekos$() or $(thing)cats$() nearby, the collector will automatically absorb their energy and the progress bar will slowly fill up. No need to right-click anything — just stand near them, meow~$(br2)The progress bar needs a total of $(#FF69B4)5000 points$() of energy.

pages.title: Producing Neko Potion
pages.text: When the collector's energy bar is full, it will automatically consume the stored energy and produce a $(item)Neko Potion$().$(br2)Once you have the potion, drink it up and you'll officially become a neko!$(br2)The collector is reusable — after each use, the energy bar resets to zero, and you can start absorbing energy again for another potion.$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Tip: The more nekos around you, the faster it fills up~$()
